name: Israir Group Ltd
summary: Israir Group Ltd., an Israeli enterprise, is primarily involved in airline operations within Israel. The company facilitates both regularly scheduled and chartered air services, connecting passengers to a diverse array of European destinations. Beyond its core aviation activities, Israir also develops and provides a range of travel experiences, including organized cruise excursions, specially designed tours and vacations for young people, and comprehensive ski packages across various European resorts. Its offerings extend to English summer school programs, exclusive boutique premium travel arrangements, and a ticketing service for sports and concert events. This company, established in 1990, has its headquarters located in Tel Aviv, Israel.
